comparison_scope: Normalized pump-energy shape only; no absolute displacement comparison, no pump-by-pump fluence correction, and no energy-axis shift.

calculation.polarization_curve: complex average of xx and yy

experiment.source: Trovatello et al., ACS Nano 14, 5700-5710 (2020), Fig. 7b
experiment.observable: Fourier amplitude of optical modulation at a fixed 2.9 eV probe

illustrative_finite_pump_shape.warning: Illustrative only: the paper reports <20 fs pulses, not each pulse spectrum.

known_model_mismatches: The experiment has strong excitons (bound electron-hole pairs); the present EPW kernel does not include them explicitly.
The experiment adjusted incident fluence with pump energy but did not publish the per-energy values.
The present calculation is no-SOC and Gamma_c only.
The experiment measures optical modulation, not an atom displacement in angstrom.
